title: Positive direct image vanishes from affine-open object acyclicity
statement: For a scheme X, a continuous additive inclusion i of its Zariski opens into its small etale site satisfying i followed by forget equals the restriction functor, a small-coefficient etale abelian sheaf F with sheafification, Ext and injective resolutions as in the Lean signature, and n a natural number: if the degree n+1 etale object cohomology of F vanishes on every affine open, then the degree n+1 right derived continuous direct image of F along i is zero.

proof.text: The inclusion equality identifies i(U) with the canonical etale open object. Every point of an open has an affine neighbourhood inside it, so affine object acyclicity makes the zero endomorphism of the restricted object-cohomology presheaf locally injective. Compare this presheaf, after coefficient universe lifts, with the homology presheaf of an injective resolution using objectCohomologyPresheaf_resolution. Exact precomposition preserves homology. Local injectivity descends through ULift and natural isomorphisms. Exact additive sheafification sends the zero endomorphism to a zero monomorphism, forcing the sheafified homology to be zero. The sheafification counit and homology comparison identify it with homology of the pushed resolution; isoRightDerivedObj then gives the claimed zero derived direct image.

proof_origin.note: Second reading by V3: corrected to affine-open acyclicity; generic direct-image criterion is now proved in Lean.

Mathlib supplies cohomologyPresheaf and local-injectivity/sheafification tools. Repository supplies etale_affine_qcoherent_succ and objectCohomologyPresheaf_resolution. PushedResolutionPositiveHomologyZero is a related proved argument, but its Scheme.{u+1} interface does not instantiate at arbitrary Scheme.{u}; this criterion uses its generic resolution dependency and the same universe-transport argument. No duplicate of affine-open tensor object acyclicity found.

lean.statement:
theorem positiveDirectImageOfObjectAcyclic
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    [i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology]
    [(i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).Additive]
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasExt.{u} (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    [HasInjectiveResolutions (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (hi : i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (hF : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U → IsZero
      (Sheaf.H' F (n + 1) (Scheme.Etale.mk U.ι))) :
    IsZero ((((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).rightDerived
      (n + 1)).obj F))
